Description: Lawton is the most affordable city in this batch, built around Fort Sill, the Army's Fires Center of Excellence and Field Artillery school in southwest Oklahoma. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Oklahoma's full exemption of military retirement pay, low housing costs, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a high crime rate, hot windy summers, no local Costco, and a limited state LGBTQ policy environment.
